doctorAbout.title: About
doctorAbout.short_description: Dr Amarnath Reddy is a Consultant in Orthopaedics at Narayana Multi speciality Hospital, HSR Bangalore. He finished his MBBS from Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Belgaum. After that he went on to complete his MS in Orthopaedics Sri Devraj Urs Medical College, Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, Bangalore. Later, he pursued a fellowship in Joint Replacement from Sunshine & St Joseph Hospital respectively. Along with that he also pursued a fellowship in Spine Surgery from Kamineni Hospital.
